sources.title: PJ-102AH DC Power Jack datasheet
sources.note: Official datasheet (HTTP 200, application/pdf). KiCad footprint Connector_BarrelJack:BarrelJack_CUI_PJ-102AH_Horizontal links an Adafruit mirror of the same drawing. Pad 1=center pin, pad 2=sleeve, pad 3=switch. Distributor listing (Digi-Key 408448) states 'Single Switch, Normally Closed'; switch is closed between pads 2-3 with no plug and opens when a plug is inserted. Schematic image is vector, text extraction incomplete; switch state confirmed by distributor description plus community notes.

sources.title: 9mm Single Metal Shaft, Multi-Ganged Series (RD901F/RD902F/RD904F) datasheet
sources.note: HTTP 200, application/pdf, 5 pages. Confirms RD901F-40-00D = single unit, vertical, with bracket, no switch. Mono-unit circuit drawing shows pins 1 and 3 as the fixed ends and pin 2 as the wiper; the extracted text does not state which end is CW. Tapers: A=log, B=linear, C=rev-log. The CW/CCW end assignment is a build-time check, not a verified fact.

sources.title: Neutrik NMJ6HFD2 and NMJ4HFD2 6.35 mm jack product pages
sources.note: KiCad footprints link these product pages: Connector_Audio:Jack_6.35mm_Neutrik_NMJ6HFD2_Horizontal (stereo, switched; pads R,S,T,RN,SN,TN) and ..._NMJ4HFD2_Horizontal (mono, switched; pads S,T,SN,TN). A mono TS plug inserted into the stereo jack shorts the ring contact to the plug sleeve, which is the standard battery-negative disconnect.

sources.title: KiCad official footprints library (master branch)
sources.note: Footprint names and pad numbers read from raw master files: Device:D/LED pin 1=K, 2=A; DIP-8 pads 1-8; TO-92_Inline pads 1-3; Neutrik jacks R/S/T/RN/SN/TN; BarrelJack_CUI_PJ-102AH pads 1-3; PinHeader_2x05 pads 1-10; MountingHole_3.2mm_M3 pad 1 NPTH.
